summary.key_theme: 市場對 AI 記憶體需求與週期性風險存在分歧，導致股價在強勁基本面預期與機構減持壓力下呈現震盪。

bullish.title: Micron Could Double From Here and Hit $1 Trillion
bullish.reason: 分析指出 Micron 受惠於強勁的 AI 記憶體週期，現金流表現優異，具備長期成長至 1 兆美元市值的潛力。

bullish.title: Micron: Strong Buy As KOSPI Fear Looks Overdone
bullish.reason: 分析師認為市場對韓國股市（KOSPI）的擔憂過度，Micron 在 AI 需求驅動下，未來幾年的獲利成長動能依然強勁。

bullish.title: Chip Rally Broadens: AI Infrastructure Supply-Chain Names Are Leading the Market
bullish.reason: 半導體市場動能轉向供應鏈，Micron 作為記憶體關鍵供應商，在 AI 基礎設施擴張中處於領先地位。

bullish.title: What's Going On With Micron Technology Stock Friday? — Micron (MU) stock ticks higher premarket on surging AI memory demand and a new $250M venture fund deployment.
bullish.reason: 公司透過 2.5 億美元的創投基金部署，顯示其在 AI 生態系的積極佈局，且市場需求持續增長。

bearish.title: Stanley Druckenmiller Bets Big on AMZN, AMD — Dumps AVGO, INTC and MU in Q2
bearish.reason: 知名投資人 Stanley Druckenmiller 在第二季大幅減持 Micron，顯示大型機構對其短期成長前景轉趨保守。

bearish.title: What's Going On With Micron Technology Stock Wednesday? — Micron stock rebounds in premarket trading after a 7% drop as Cathie Wood warns high-bandwidth memory prices face cyclic
bearish.reason: Cathie Wood 警告高頻寬記憶體（HBM）價格面臨週期性壓力，引發市場對記憶體價格觸頂的擔憂。

neutral.title: Micron: Inventory Does Not Lie (Rating Upgrade)
neutral.reason: 評級上調至「持有」，主要因股價修正 20% 後估值風險降低，但並未給予買進評級，顯示觀望態度。

neutral.title: What's Going On With Micron Technology Stock Thursday? — Micron stock edges up in premarket trading as technicals support its long-term uptrend.
neutral.reason: 僅基於技術面分析股價支撐與壓力位，缺乏基本面重大消息驅動。
